travel.title: Travel fee
travel.text: There is no travel fee in Kaunas or within 20 km of the city boundary. Beyond that area, a €0.50/km round-trip fee may apply; we agree the final price before the visit.

hero.title: How the inspection works
hero.text: From the listing link to findings about the car's condition.

process.finish: The decision stayed in my hands.

step1.label: Before the visit
step1.title: I sent the listing link.
step1.text: I chose a service and time and shared the car's location. I received the visit confirmation by email.

step2.label: At the vehicle
step2.title: The car was checked where it stood.
step2.text: The specialist came to the car and performed the service I chose. A full inspection includes a test drive when conditions allow.

step3.label: After the inspection
step3.title: I got a clear explanation.
step3.text: After a full inspection, I received photos, the issues found, and a conclusion. Diagnostic results are explained briefly.
